shortDescription: The Network360 Team is excited to share the latest updates designed to enhance your user experience on the Disruption platform.
body:
The Network360 Team is excited to share the latest updates designed to enhance your user experience on the Disruption platform. Here’s what’s new in this release: * Utilization Files Button on Landing Page for Easier Navigation. * Clearer and More Helpful Error Messages. ## Enhancements
### 1. Utilization Files Button on Landing Page for Easier Navigation We’ve added a **Utilization Files** button to the **Landing Page**, making it quicker to access your imported files. ![](/cms/cms-assets/media/first-image.png) **What you’ll see:** * The **Utilization Files** button will appear after you’ve imported a file. * Clicking it will take you directly to the **Utilization Files Page**, where you can easily navigate to the **Processing Files Page**. **How this helps you:** * Faster navigation to your files with fewer clicks. ### 2. Clearer and More Helpful Error Messages We’ve made it easier to understand and act when something unexpected happens. Now, if an error occurs, you’ll see a clear, user-friendly message guiding you on the next steps. ![](/cms/cms-assets/media/second-image.png) **What you’ll see:** * A simple and actionable message like: **"An unexpected error occurred. Please try again later. If the issue persists, contact support."** **How this helps you:** * Guidance on what to do next, whether that’s retrying or getting help from support. ## Conclusion These updates are designed to make your experience on the Disruption platform smoother and more intuitive with easier navigation and clearer error messages. We’re committed to continuously improving the platform to meet your needs. As always, if you have any questions or need support, feel free to reach out to our team. We’re here to help!
